_comment: ElevenLabs 효과음 주문서. 이름은 scripts/ui/sfx.gd의 소리 이름과 같다. .github/workflows/make-sfx.yml이 이 파일을 읽어 만든다. seconds는 0.5~30.

sounds.name: click
sounds.text: Soft bubbly UI button tap, short cute pop, casual mobile game

sounds.name: step
sounds.text: Single light wooden game piece hop on a board, short tok

sounds.name: dice
sounds.text: Two dice shaken and rolled on a wooden table, rattling then settling

sounds.name: hit
sounds.text: Cartoon sword hit, short punchy slash impact, game combat

sounds.name: win
sounds.text: Short bright victory jingle, cheerful brass and bells, casual mobile game

sounds.name: lose
sounds.text: Short sad descending jingle, gentle, casual mobile game fail

sounds.name: good
sounds.text: Positive chime, two rising marimba notes, reward pickup

sounds.name: bad
sounds.text: Negative low buzz, two falling notes, soft error, casual game

sounds.name: reveal
sounds.text: Magical reveal swell, rising shimmer, card flip reveal

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.text: Fast airy whoosh swipe, UI banner sliding in

sounds.name: impact
sounds.text: Heavy cinematic drum impact, deep boom with short tail

sounds.name: sparkle
sounds.text: Glittering sparkle twinkle, high bells, magical dust

sounds.name: card
sounds.text: Playing card dealt, quick paper flick

sounds.name: skill
sounds.text: Hero special ability activation, energy charge up then burst, anime game

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.text: Triumphant short fanfare, brass and drums, game match victory

sounds.name: defeat
sounds.text: Somber short defeat sting, low strings descending, game over

sounds.name: fling
sounds.text: Cartoon character knocked back flying away, descending whistle

sounds.name: land
sounds.text: Soft thud landing on ground, short

sounds.name: coin
sounds.text: Coins collected, bright metallic clink, game reward
